name: Ikenai Kozukuri 4 ~Namaiki na Aneki ga Jitsu wa Ore no Semen ga Daisuki Datta!?~
original_name: いけない子作り４ ～生意気な姉貴が実は俺のザーメンが大好きだった！？～
source:
The protagonist is currently living together with his older sister and going to prep school everyday. He likes her but is unable to be honest about his feelings.

One day, he comes home early and see his sister masturbating while sniffing his shorts. At the height of his arousal, he unintentionally has sex with her.

After doing the deed and being questioned if she likes him, his sister denies it on the ground that she only likes his scent.

While disappointed at her words, he is delighted to know that from now on, he can make her do anything using his smell.

[Translated from [url=http://www.boot.eroit.net/ikenaikodukuri4/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角现在和姐姐住在一起，每天都去预科学校。他喜欢她，但无法诚实地表达自己的感受。

有一天，他提前回家，看到妹妹一边自慰，一边嗅着他的短裤。在他性欲最旺盛的时候，他无意中与她发生了性关系。

在做了这件事并被问及是否喜欢他后，他的妹妹否认了，理由是她只喜欢他的气味。

虽然对她的话感到失望，但他很高兴知道，从现在起，他可以用他的气味让她做任何事。
